The '''PL-2G Defender Droid''' was a type of small [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The PL-2G Defender Droid was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a pet with patch 5.2.1. and is available from a promotional event.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
